   239→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   240→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   241→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review issues.
   242→
   243→Your plan should:
   244→- Cluster issues by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   245→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   246→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   247→- Dismiss issues that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   248→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   249→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   250→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all issues coherently
   251→
   252→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   253→
   254→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   255→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   256→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   257→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   258→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   259→- `desloppify plan resolve <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   260→- `desloppify plan reorder <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   261→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   262→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   263→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review issues
   264→
   265→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Issues not assigned to any epic
   266→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed issues will be
   267→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   268→
   269→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   270→{
   271→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   272→  "epics": [
   273→    {
   274→      "name": "slug-name",
   275→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   276→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   277→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   278→      "issue_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   279→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   280→      "agent_safe": true,
   281→      "dependency_order": 1,
   282→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   283→      "status": "pending"
   284→    }
   285→  ],
   286→  "dismissed_issues": [
   287→    {"issue_id": "id", "reason": "why this issue doesn't make sense"}
   288→  ],
   289→  "contradiction_notes": [
   290→    {"kept": "issue_id", "dismissed": "issue_id", "reason": "why"}
   291→  ],
   292→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   293→}
   294→"""
   295→
   296→
   297→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   298→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   299→    parts: list[str] = []
   300→
   301→    # Section: existing epics
   302→    if si.existing_epics:
   303→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   304→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   305→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   306→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   307→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   308→            fids = epic.get("issue_ids", [])
   309→            parts.append(
   310→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   311→                f"\n  Issues: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   312→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   313→            )
   314→        parts.append("")
   315→
   316→    # Section: what changed
   317→    if si.new_since_last:
   318→        parts.append(f"## New issues since last triage ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   319→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   320→            f = si.open_issues.get(fid, {})
   321→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   322→        parts.append("")
   323→
   324→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   325→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last triage ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   326→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   327→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   328→        parts.append("")
   329→
   330→    # Section: all open review issues
   331→    parts.append(f"## All open review issues ({len(si.open_issues)})")
   332→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_issues.items()):
   333→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   334→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   335→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   336→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   337→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   338→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   339→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   340→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   341→        if dimension:
   342→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   343→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   344→        if suggestion:
   345→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   346→    parts.append("")
   347→
   348→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   349→    if si.dimension_scores:
   350→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   351→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   352→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   353→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   354→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   355→                issues = data.get("failing", 0)
   356→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   357→        parts.append("")
   358→
   359→    # Section: previously dismissed
   360→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   361→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   362→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   363→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   364→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   365→        parts.append("")
   366→
   367→    return "\n".join(parts)

   373→
   374→def parse_triage_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> TriageResult:
   375→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a TriageResult.
   376→
   377→    Invalid issue IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   378→    """
   379→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   380→
   381→    epics: list[dict] = []
   382→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   383→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   384→            continue
   385→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   386→        if not name:
   387→            continue
   388→        # Validate direction
   389→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   390→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   391→            direction = "simplify"
   392→        # Filter to valid issue IDs
   393→        issue_ids = [
   394→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("issue_ids", [])
   395→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   396→        ]
   397→        dismissed = [
   398→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   399→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   400→        ]
   401→        action_steps = [
   402→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   403→            if isinstance(s, str)
   404→        ]
   405→
   406→        epics.append({
   407→            "name": name,
   408→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   409→            "direction": direction,
   410→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   411→            "issue_ids": issue_ids,
   412→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   413→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   414→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   415→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   416→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   417→        })
   418→
   419→    dismissed_issues: list[DismissedIssue] = []
   420→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_issues", []):
   421→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   422→            continue
   423→        fid = str(d.get("issue_id", ""))
   424→        if fid in valid_ids:
   425→            dismissed_issues.append(
   426→                DismissedIssue(issue_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   427→            )
   428→
   429→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   430→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   431→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   432→            continue
   433→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   434→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   435→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   436→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   437→        ))
   438→
   439→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   440→
   441→    return TriageResult(
   442→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   443→        epics=epics,
   444→        dismissed_issues=dismissed_issues,
   445→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   446→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   447→    )
   448→

   450→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   451→# Plan mutation
   452→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   453→
   454→def apply_triage_to_plan(
   455→    plan: PlanModel,
   456→    state: StateModel,
   457→    triage: TriageResult,
   458→    *,
   459→    trigger: str = "manual",
   460→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   461→    """Apply parsed triage result to the living plan.
   462→
   463→    1. Creates/updates triage-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   464→    2. Marks dismissed issues as triaged_out skips
   465→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   466→    4. Updates epic_triage_meta with snapshot hash
   467→    """
   468→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   469→    now = utc_now()
   470→    result = TriageMutationResult()
   471→    result.strategy_summary = triage.strategy_summary
   472→

   620→def triage_epics(
   621→    plan: PlanModel,
   622→    state: StateModel,
   623→    *,
   624→    deps: TriageDeps | None = None,
   625→    dry_run: bool = False,
   626→    trigger: str = "manual",
   627→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   628→    """Run epic triage: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   629→
   630→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   631→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   632→
   633→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   634→    """
   635→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   636→    si = collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   637→
   638→    prompt = build_triage_prompt(si)
   639→    valid_ids = set(si.open_issues.keys())
   640→
   641→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   642→        result = TriageMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   643→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_issues)} issues"
   644→        return result
   645→
   646→    # Call LLM
   647→    try:
   648→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   649→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   650→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   651→        logger.error("Epic triage LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   652→        result = TriageMutationResult()
   653→        result.strategy_summary = f"Triage failed: {exc}"
   654→        return result
   655→
   656→    triage = parse_triage_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   657→    return apply_triage_to_plan(plan, state, triage, trigger=trigger)
   658→

    24→def _summary_similarity(a: str, b: str) -> float:
    25→    left = normalize_word_set(a)
    26→    right = normalize_word_set(b)
    27→    if not left or not right:
    28→        return 0.0
    29→    overlap = len(left & right)
    30→    union = len(left | right)
    31→    return float(overlap) / float(union) if union else 0.0
    32→
    33→
    34→def _parse_holistic_identifier(issue_id: str) -> str:
    35→    parts = [part for part in str(issue_id).split("::") if part]
    36→    if len(parts) < 2:
    37→        return ""
    38→    candidate = parts[-2].strip()
    39→    if not candidate or candidate in {"holistic", "changed", "stale", "unreviewed"}:
    40→        return ""
    41→    return candidate
    42→
    43→
    44→def _related_files_set(issue: dict) -> set[str]:
    45→    related = issue.get("detail", {}).get("related_files", [])
    46→    if not isinstance(related, list):
    47→        return set()
    48→    return {str(path).strip() for path in related if str(path).strip()}
    49→
    50→
    51→def _same_issue_concept(
    52→    left: dict,
    53→    right: dict,
    54→    *,
    55→    similarity_threshold: float,
    56→) -> bool:
    57→    left_detail = left.get("detail", {})
    58→    right_detail = right.get("detail", {})
    59→    if left_detail.get("dimension") != right_detail.get("dimension"):
    60→        return False
    61→
    62→    left_summary = str(left.get("summary", "")).strip()
    63→    right_summary = str(right.get("summary", "")).strip()
    64→    similarity = _summary_similarity(left_summary, right_summary)
    65→
    66→    left_files = _related_files_set(left)
    67→    right_files = _related_files_set(right)
    68→    files_overlap = not left_files or not right_files or bool(left_files & right_files)
    69→
    70→    left_identifier = _parse_holistic_identifier(left.get("id", ""))
    71→    right_identifier = _parse_holistic_identifier(right.get("id", ""))
    72→    if left_identifier and right_identifier and left_identifier == right_identifier:
    73→        # Identifier match still requires at least one corroborating signal
    74→        return similarity >= 0.3 or files_overlap
    75→
    76→    if similarity < similarity_threshold:
    77→        return False
    78→    if not files_overlap:
    79→        return False
    80→    return True

    89→    track_merged_from(primary_detail, duplicate.get("id", ""))

   154→    merged_pairs: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []

   156→        ranked = sorted(
   157→            group,
   158→            key=lambda issue: (issue_weight(issue)[0], issue.get("id", "")),
   159→            reverse=True,
   160→        )
   161→        primary = ranked[0]
   162→        duplicates = ranked[1:]
   163→        merged_pairs.append((primary.get("id", ""), [d.get("id", "") for d in duplicates]))
   164→        if dry_run:
   165→            continue
   166→        for duplicate in duplicates:
   167→            _merge_issue_details(primary, duplicate)
   168→            duplicate["status"] = "auto_resolved"
   169→            duplicate["resolved_at"] = timestamp
   170→            duplicate["note"] = f"merged into {primary.get('id', '')}"
   171→            duplicate["resolution_attestation"] = {
   172→                "kind": "issue_merge",
   173→                "text": "Merged conceptually duplicate review issue",
   174→                "attested_at": timestamp,
   175→                "scan_verified": False,
   176→            }
   177→        primary_detail = primary.setdefault("detail", {})
   178→        primary_detail["merged_at"] = timestamp
   179→
   180→    print(
   181→        colorize(
   182→            f"\n  Merge groups: {len(merge_groups)} | "
   183→            f"duplicate issues: {sum(len(group) - 1 for group in merge_groups)}",
   184→            "bold",
   185→        )
   186→    )
   187→    for index, (primary_id, duplicate_ids) in enumerate(merged_pairs, 1):
   188→        preview = ", ".join(duplicate_ids[:3])
   189→        if len(duplicate_ids) > 3:
   190→            preview = f"{preview}, +{len(duplicate_ids) - 3} more"
   191→        print(colorize(f"  [{index}] keep {primary_id}", "dim"))
   192→        print(colorize(f"      merge {preview}", "dim"))
   193→
   194→    if dry_run:
   195→        print(colorize("\n  Dry run only: no state changes written.\n", "yellow"))
   196→        return
   197→
   198→    save_state(state, state_file)
   199→    print(colorize("\n  State updated with merged issue groups.", "green"))
   200→    show_score_with_plan_context(state, prev)
   201→    write_query(
   202→        {
   203→            "command": "review",
   204→            "action": "merge",
   205→            "groups": len(merge_groups),
   206→            "duplicates_merged": sum(len(group) - 1 for group in merge_groups),
   207→            "next_command": "desloppify show review --status open",
   208→            "narrative": narrative,

    37→    summary_similarity_signal = False

    40→        union = len(existing_summary | incoming_summary)

    72→class ScanStateContractError(ValueError):
    73→    """Raised when persisted scan state violates required runtime contracts."""

    76→def _clear_needs_rescan_flag(config: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    77→    """Best-effort clear for config.needs_rescan after a successful scan merge."""
    78→    if not config.get("needs_rescan"):
    79→        return
    80→    try:
    81→        config["needs_rescan"] = False
    82→        _save_config(config)
    83→    except OSError as exc:
    84→        _ = exc
    85→        config["needs_rescan"] = True
    86→

    88→def _plan_has_user_content(plan: dict[str, object]) -> bool:
    89→    """Return True when the living plan has any user-managed queue metadata."""
    90→    return bool(
    91→        plan.get("queue_order")
    92→        or plan.get("overrides")
    93→        or plan.get("clusters")
    94→        or plan.get("skipped")
    95→    )
    96→
    97→
    98→def _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, reconcile_fn) -> bool:
    99→    """Apply standard post-scan plan reconciliation when user content exists."""
   100→    if not _plan_has_user_content(plan):
   101→        return False
   102→    recon = reconcile_fn(plan, state)
   103→    if recon.resurfaced:
   104→        print(
   105→            colorize(
   106→                f"  Plan: {len(recon.resurfaced)} skipped item(s) re-surfaced after review period.",
   107→                "cyan",
   108→            )
   109→        )
   110→    return bool(recon.changes)
   111→

   113→def _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, sync_fn) -> bool:
   114→    """Sync unscored subjective dimensions into the plan queue."""
   115→    sync = sync_fn(plan, state)
   116→    if sync.injected:
   117→        print(
   118→            colorize(
   119→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.injected)} unscored subjective dimension(s) queued for initial review.",
   120→                "cyan",
   121→            )
   122→        )
   123→    return bool(sync.changes)
   124→
   125→
   126→def _sync_stale_dimensions(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, sync_fn) -> bool:
   127→    """Sync stale subjective dimensions (prune refreshed + inject stale) in plan queue."""
   128→    sync = sync_fn(plan, state)
   129→    if sync.pruned:
   130→        print(
   131→            colorize(
   132→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.pruned)} refreshed subjective dimension(s) removed from queue.",
   133→                "cyan",
   134→            )
   135→        )
   136→    if sync.injected:
   137→        print(
   138→            colorize(
   139→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.injected)} subjective dimension(s) queued for review.",
   140→                "cyan",
   141→            )
   142→        )
   143→    return bool(sync.changes)

   147→    plan: dict[str, object],

   149→    *,
   150→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
   151→    policy=None,
   152→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,

   163→def _seed_plan_start_scores(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel) -> bool:
   164→    """Set plan_start_scores when beginning a new queue cycle."""
   165→    existing = plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   166→    if existing and not isinstance(existing, dict):
   167→        return False
   168→    # Seed when empty OR when it's the reset sentinel ({"reset": True})
   169→    if existing and not existing.get("reset"):
   170→        return False
   171→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   172→    if scores.strict is None:
   173→        return False
   174→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {
   175→        "strict": scores.strict,
   176→        "overall": scores.overall,
   177→        "objective": scores.objective,
   178→        "verified": scores.verified,
   179→    }
   180→    return True
   181→
   182→
   183→def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(
   184→    state: state_mod.StateModel, plan: dict[str, object]
   185→) -> bool:
   186→    """Clear plan-start score snapshot once the queue is fully drained."""
   187→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   188→        return False
   189→
   190→    try:
   191→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_breakdown
   192→
   193→        breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   194→        queue_empty = breakdown.actionable == 0
   195→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   196→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   197→        return False
   198→    if not queue_empty:
   199→        return False
   200→    state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"] = dict(plan["plan_start_scores"])
   201→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   202→    return True
   203→
   204→
   205→def _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: "ScanRuntime") -> None:
   206→    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
   207→    try:
   208→        plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
   209→        plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   210→        dirty = False
   211→
   212→        if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
   213→            dirty = True
   214→
   215→        unscored_changed = _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_unscored_dimensions)
   216→        if unscored_changed:
   217→            dirty = True
   218→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_unscored", actor="system",
   219→                             detail={"changes": True})
   220→
   221→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score import target_strict_score_from_config
   222→        _target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   223→
   224→        # Compute subjective visibility policy once for consistent gating
   225→        from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_subjective_visibility
   226→        _policy = compute_subjective_visibility(
   227→            runtime.state,
   228→            target_strict=_target_strict,
   229→            plan=plan,
   230→        )
   231→
   232→        # Detect cycle completion: plan_start_scores is empty when the
   233→        # previous cycle drained the queue and revealed scores.  In that
   234→        # case stale subjective dimensions should be prioritized over new
   235→        # objective issues so the user reviews before a new cycle begins.
   236→        _cycle_just_completed = not plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   237→
   238→        stale_changed = _sync_stale_dimensions(
   239→            plan, runtime.state,
   240→            lambda p, s: sync_stale_dimensions(
   241→                p, s, policy=_policy, cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed,
   242→            ),
   243→        )
   244→        if stale_changed:
   245→            dirty = True
   246→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_stale", actor="system",
   247→                             detail={"changes": True})
   248→
   249→        auto_changed = _sync_auto_clusters(
   250→            plan, runtime.state, target_strict=_target_strict, policy=_policy,
   251→            cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed,
   252→        )
   253→        if auto_changed:
   254→            dirty = True
   255→            append_log_entry(plan, "auto_cluster", actor="system",
   256→                             detail={"changes": True})
   257→
   258→        triage_sync = sync_triage_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   259→        if triage_sync.changes:
   260→            dirty = True
   261→            if triage_sync.injected:
   262→                print(
   263→                    colorize(
   264→                        "  Plan: planning mode needed — review issues changed since last triage.",
   265→                        "cyan",
   266→                    )
   267→                )
   268→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_triage", actor="system",
   269→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   270→
   271→        checkpoint_sync = sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   272→        if checkpoint_sync.changes:
   273→            dirty = True
   274→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_score_checkpoint", actor="system",
   275→                             detail={"injected": True})
   276→
   277→        create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   278→        if create_plan_sync.changes:
   279→            dirty = True
   280→            if create_plan_sync.injected:
   281→                print(
   282→                    colorize(
   283→                        "  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.",
   284→                        "cyan",
   285→                    )
   286→                )
   287→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system",
   288→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   289→
   290→        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
   291→        if seeded:
   292→            dirty = True
   293→            append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system",
   294→                             detail={})
   295→        # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   296→        # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   297→        if not seeded and _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(runtime.state, plan):
   298→            dirty = True
   299→            append_log_entry(plan, "clear_start_scores", actor="system",
   300→                             detail={})
   301→
   302→        if dirty:
   303→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   304→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   305→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   306→

   308→def _state_subjective_assessments(
   309→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   310→) -> dict[str, object]:
   311→    """Return normalized subjective assessment store from state."""
   312→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
   313→    if isinstance(assessments, dict):
   314→        return assessments
   315→    raise ScanStateContractError(
   316→        "state.subjective_assessments must be an object; rerun with a valid state file"
   317→    )
   318→
   319→
   320→def _state_lang_capabilities(
   321→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   322→) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
   323→    """Return normalized language capability map from state."""
   324→    capabilities = state.get("lang_capabilities")
   325→    if capabilities is None:
   326→        normalized: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
   327→        state["lang_capabilities"] = normalized
   328→        return normalized
   329→    if isinstance(capabilities, dict):
   330→        return capabilities
   331→    raise ScanStateContractError(
   332→        "state.lang_capabilities must be an object when present"
   333→    )
   334→

   336→def _state_issues(state: state_mod.StateModel) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
   337→    """Return normalized issue map from state."""
   338→    issues = state.get("issues")
   339→    if isinstance(issues, dict):
   340→        return issues
   341→    raise ScanStateContractError(
   342→        "state.issues must be an object; state file appears corrupted"
   343→    )

   393→def _configure_lang_runtime(
   394→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   395→    config: dict[str, object],
   396→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   397→    lang: LangRun | None,
   398→) -> LangRun | None:
   399→    """Populate runtime context and threshold overrides for a selected language."""
   400→    if not lang:
   401→        return None
   402→
   403→    lang_options = resolve_lang_runtime_options(args, lang)
   404→    lang_settings = resolve_lang_settings(config, lang)
   405→    runtime_lang = make_lang_run(
   406→        lang,
   407→        overrides=LangRunOverrides(
   408→            review_cache=state.get("review_cache", {}),
   409→            review_max_age_days=config.get("review_max_age_days", 30),
   410→            runtime_settings=lang_settings,
   411→            runtime_options=lang_options,
   412→            large_threshold_override=config.get("large_files_threshold", 0),
   413→            props_threshold_override=config.get("props_threshold", 0),
   414→        ),
   415→    )
   416→
   417→    lang_capabilities = _state_lang_capabilities(state)
   418→    lang_capabilities[runtime_lang.name] = {
   419→        "fixers": sorted(runtime_lang.fixers.keys()),
   420→        "typecheck_cmd": runtime_lang.typecheck_cmd,
   421→    }
   422→    return runtime_lang

   424→
   425→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   426→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   427→    *,
   428→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   429→) -> int:
   430→    """Reset known subjective dimensions to 0 so the next scan starts fresh."""
   431→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   432→
   433→    reset_keys = {
   434→        key.strip()
   435→        for key in assessments
   436→        if isinstance(key, str) and key.strip()
   437→    }
   438→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   439→
   440→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   441→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   442→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   443→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   444→            payload["score"] = 0.0
   445→            payload["source"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   446→            payload["assessed_at"] = now
   447→            payload["reset_by"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   448→            payload["placeholder"] = True
   449→            payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   450→            payload.pop("components", None)
   451→            payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   452→            continue
   453→        assessments[key] = {
   454→            "score": 0.0,
   455→            "source": "scan_reset_subjective",
   456→            "assessed_at": now,
   457→            "reset_by": "scan_reset_subjective",
   458→            "placeholder": True,
   459→        }
   460→    return len(reset_keys)
   461→
   462→
   463→def _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   464→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   465→) -> int:
   466→    """Expire provisional manual-override assessments at scan start."""
   467→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   468→
   469→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   470→    expired = 0
   471→    for payload in assessments.values():
   472→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   473→            continue
   474→        if payload.get("provisional_override") is not True:
   475→            continue
   476→        payload["score"] = 0.0
   477→        payload["source"] = "manual_override_expired"
   478→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   479→        payload["reset_by"] = "manual_override_expired"
   480→        payload["placeholder"] = True
   481→        payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   482→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   483→        payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   484→        payload.pop("components", None)
   485→        payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   486→        expired += 1
   487→    return expired
   488→

   490→def prepare_scan_runtime(args) -> ScanRuntime:
   491→    """Resolve state/config/language and apply scan-time runtime settings."""
   492→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   493→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   494→    state = runtime.state if isinstance(runtime.state, dict) else {}
   495→    state_mod.ensure_state_defaults(state)
   496→    path = Path(args.path)
   497→    config = runtime.config if isinstance(runtime.config, dict) else {}
   498→    lang_config = resolve_lang(args)
   499→    reset_subjective_count = 0
   500→    expired_manual_override_count = _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   501→        state
   502→    )
   503→    if getattr(args, "reset_subjective", False):
   504→        reset_subjective_count = _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   505→            state,
   506→            lang_name=getattr(lang_config, "name", None),
   507→        )
   508→
   509→    include_slow = not getattr(args, "skip_slow", False)
   510→    profile = _resolve_scan_profile(getattr(args, "profile", None), lang_config)
   511→    effective_include_slow = _effective_include_slow(include_slow, profile)
   512→
   513→    lang = _configure_lang_runtime(args, config, state, lang_config)
   514→    coverage_warnings = _seed_runtime_coverage_warnings(lang)
   515→    zone_overrides_raw = config.get("zone_overrides")
   516→    zone_overrides = zone_overrides_raw if isinstance(zone_overrides_raw, dict) else None
   517→
   518→    return ScanRuntime(
   519→        args=args,
   520→        state_path=state_file,
   521→        state=state,
   522→        path=path,
   523→        config=config,
   524→        lang=lang,
   525→        lang_label=f" ({lang.name})" if lang else "",
   526→        profile=profile,
   527→        effective_include_slow=effective_include_slow,
   528→        zone_overrides=zone_overrides,
   529→        reset_subjective_count=reset_subjective_count,
   530→        expired_manual_override_count=expired_manual_override_count,
   531→        coverage_warnings=coverage_warnings,
   532→    )
   533→

   535→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_issues(
   536→    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],
   537→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   538→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   539→    """Append stale exclude issues when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   540→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   541→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   542→        return issues
   543→
   544→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   545→    stale = _audit_excluded_dirs(
   546→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, PROJECT_ROOT
   547→    )
   548→    if not stale:
   549→        return issues
   550→
   551→    augmented = list(issues)
   552→    augmented.extend(stale)
   553→    for stale_issue in stale:
   554→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_issue['summary']}", "dim"))
   555→    return augmented
   556→

   558→def _augment_with_stale_wontfix_issues(
   559→    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],
   560→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   561→    *,
   562→    decay_scans: int,
   563→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:
   564→    """Append re-triage issues for stale/worsening wontfix debt."""
   565→    return _augment_stale_wontfix_impl(
   566→        issues,
   567→        state=runtime.state,
   568→        scan_path=runtime.path,
   569→        project_root=PROJECT_ROOT,
   570→        decay_scans=decay_scans,
   571→    )

   573→
   574→def run_scan_generation(
   575→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   576→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   577→    """Run detector pipeline and return issues, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   578→    enable_file_cache()
   579→    enable_parse_cache()
   580→    try:
   581→        issues, potentials = plan_mod.generate_issues(
   582→            runtime.path,
   583→            lang=runtime.lang,
   584→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   585→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   586→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   587→                profile=runtime.profile,
   588→            ),
   589→        )
   590→    finally:
   591→        disable_parse_cache()
   592→        disable_file_cache()
   593→
   594→    codebase_metrics = _collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   595→    _warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   596→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   597→    )
   598→    issues = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_issues(issues, runtime)
   599→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   600→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   601→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   602→    )
   603→    issues, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_issues(
   604→        issues,
   605→        runtime,
   606→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   607→    )
   608→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   609→    return issues, potentials, codebase_metrics
   610→
   611→
   612→def merge_scan_results(
   613→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   614→    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],
   615→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   616→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   617→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   618→    """Merge issues into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   619→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   620→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   621→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   622→
   623→    if not path_changed:
   624→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   625→    else:
   626→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   627→    prev_dim_scores = (
   628→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   629→    )
   630→
   631→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   632→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   633→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   634→
   635→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   636→
   637→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   638→        runtime.state,
   639→        issues,
   640→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   641→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   642→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   643→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   644→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   645→            potentials=potentials,
   646→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   647→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   648→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   649→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   650→        ),
   651→    )
   652→
   653→    issues_mod.expire_stale_holistic(
   654→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   655→    )
   656→    state_mod.save_state(
   657→        runtime.state,
   658→        runtime.state_path,
   659→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   660→    )
   661→
   662→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   663→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   664→
   665→    return ScanMergeResult(
   666→        diff=diff,
   667→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   668→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   669→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   670→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   671→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   672→    )
   673→
   674→
   675→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   676→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   677→    config: dict[str, object],
   678→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   679→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden issue counters."""
   680→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   681→        state_mod.resolve_issue_noise_settings(config)
   682→    )
   683→    issues_by_id = _state_issues(state)
   684→    open_issues = [
   685→        issue
   686→        for issue in state_mod.path_scoped_issues(
   687→            issues_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   688→        ).values()
   689→        if issue.get("status") == "open"
   690→    ]
   691→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_issue_noise_budget(
   692→        open_issues,
   693→        budget=noise_budget,
   694→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   695→    )
   696→
   697→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   698→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   699→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   700→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   701→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   702→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   703→    )
   704→
   705→
   706→def persist_reminder_history(
   707→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   708→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   709→) -> None:
   710→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   711→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   712→        return
   713→
   714→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   715→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   716→    state_mod.save_state(
   717→        runtime.state,
   718→        runtime.state_path,
   719→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   720→    )
   721→
   722→
   723→__all__ = [
   724→    "ScanStateContractError",
   725→    "ScanMergeResult",
   726→    "ScanNoiseSnapshot",
   727→    "ScanRuntime",
   728→    "merge_scan_results",
   729→    "persist_reminder_history",
   730→    "prepare_scan_runtime",
   731→    "resolve_noise_snapshot",
   732→    "run_scan_generation",
   733→]
   734→

   211→        communicate_sync = sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   212→        if communicate_sync.changes:
   213→            dirty = True
   214→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_communicate_score", actor="system",
   215→                             detail={"injected": True})
   216→
   217→        create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   218→        if create_plan_sync.changes:
   219→            dirty = True
   220→            if create_plan_sync.injected:
   221→                print(

   223→                        "  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.",
   224→                        "cyan",
   225→                    )
   226→                )
   227→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system",
   228→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   229→
   230→        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
   231→        if seeded:
   232→            dirty = True
   233→            append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system",
   234→                             detail={})
   235→        # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   236→        # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   237→        if not seeded and _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(runtime.state, plan):
   238→            dirty = True
   239→            append_log_entry(plan, "clear_start_scores", actor="system",
   240→                             detail={})
   241→
   242→        if dirty:
   243→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   244→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   245→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)

   180→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   183→
   184→def _after_promoted(order: list[str], plan: PlanModel) -> int:
   185→    """Return the insertion index just after the last promoted item in *order*.
   186→
   187→    When no promoted items are present (or none are in *order*), returns 0
   188→    so callers fall back to existing front-of-queue behavior.
   189→    """
   190→    promoted = set(plan.get("promoted_ids", []))
   191→    if not promoted:
   192→        return 0
   193→    last_idx = -1
   194→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   195→        if fid in promoted:
   196→            last_idx = i
   197→    return last_idx + 1 if last_idx >= 0 else 0

   200→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   201→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   202→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   203→
   204→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   205→    plan: PlanModel,
   206→    state: StateModel,
   207→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   208→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   209→
   210→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   211→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   212→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   213→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   214→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   215→    """
   216→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   217→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   218→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   219→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   220→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   221→
   222→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   223→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   224→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   225→        fid for fid in order
   226→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   227→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   228→        and fid not in stale_ids
   229→    ]
   230→    for fid in to_remove:
   231→        order.remove(fid)
   232→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   233→
   234→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   235→    existing = set(order)
   236→    insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   237→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   238→        if uid not in existing:
   239→            order.insert(insert_at, uid)
   240→            result.injected.append(uid)
   241→
   242→    return result
   243→

   245→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   246→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   247→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   248→
   249→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   250→    plan: PlanModel,
   251→    state: StateModel,
   252→    *,
   253→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   254→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   255→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   256→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   257→
   258→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   259→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   260→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   261→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   262→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   263→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   264→          review takes priority over new objective issues).
   265→    """
   266→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   267→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   268→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   269→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   270→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   271→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   272→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   273→
   274→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   275→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   276→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   277→        fid for fid in order
   278→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   279→        and fid not in injectable_ids
   280→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   281→    ]
   282→    for fid in to_remove:
   283→        order.remove(fid)
   284→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   285→
   286→    # --- Inject or evict stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   287→    if policy is not None:
   288→        has_real_items = policy.has_objective_backlog
   289→    else:
   290→        has_real_items = any(
   291→            f.get("status") == "open"
   292→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   293→            and not f.get("suppressed")
   294→            for f in state.get("issues", {}).values()
   295→        )
   296→
   297→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   298→
   299→    if not should_inject:
   300→        # Mid-cycle with objective backlog: evict any stale/under-target IDs
   301→        # that are present in the queue.  They may have been grandfathered from
   302→        # the unscored phase and should not be visible until the objective
   303→        # backlog clears or a cycle completes.
   304→        to_evict = [
   305→            fid for fid in order
   306→            if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   307→            and fid in injectable_ids
   308→        ]
   309→        for fid in to_evict:
   310→            order.remove(fid)
   311→            result.pruned.append(fid)
   312→
   313→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   314→        existing = set(order)
   315→        if cycle_just_completed and has_real_items:
   316→            # Post-cycle: front-of-queue after promoted items so subjective
   317→            # review happens before the new objective cycle begins.
   318→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   319→            for sid in reversed(sorted(injectable_ids)):
   320→                if sid not in existing:
   321→                    order.insert(insert_at, sid)
   322→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   323→        else:
   324→            # Mid-cycle or no objective backlog: append to back.
   325→            for sid in sorted(injectable_ids):
   326→                if sid not in existing:
   327→                    order.append(sid)
   328→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   329→
   330→    return result

   336→
   337→def review_issue_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   338→    """Hash open review issue IDs to detect changes.
   339→
   340→    Returns empty string when there are no open review issues.
   341→    """
   342→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   343→    review_ids = sorted(
   344→        fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   345→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   346→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   347→    )
   348→    if not review_ids:
   349→        return ""
   350→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

   353→@dataclass
   354→class TriageSyncResult:
   355→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   356→

   364→
   365→def sync_triage_needed(
   366→    plan: PlanModel,
   367→    state: StateModel,
   368→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   369→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review issues change.
   370→
   371→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   372→
   373→    When stages are already present but all new issues have been resolved
   374→    since injection, auto-prunes the stale stages and updates the hash.
   375→
   376→    When issues are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   377→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   378→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   379→    """
   380→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   381→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   382→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   383→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   384→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   385→
   386→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   387→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   388→
   389→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   390→    last_hash = meta.get("issue_snapshot_hash", "")
   391→
   392→    if already_present:
   393→        # Stages present — check if the reason for injection still applies.
   394→        # Only auto-prune when triage was completed before (hash exists),
   395→        # all new issues have been resolved, and no triage work is in
   396→        # progress.  This avoids pruning the initial triage or a
   397→        # user-started triage session.
   398→        if last_hash and not confirmed:
   399→            issues = state.get("issues", {})
   400→            current_review_ids = {
   401→                fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   402→                if f.get("status") == "open"
   403→                and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   404→            }
   405→            triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   406→            new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   407→
   408→            if not new_since_triage:
   409→                # No new issues remain — prune stale stages
   410→                for sid in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS:
   411→                    while sid in order:
   412→                        order.remove(sid)
   413→                if current_hash:
   414→                    meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   415→                    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   416→                result.pruned = True
   417→        return result
   418→
   419→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash:
   420→        # Distinguish "new issues appeared" from "issues were resolved".
   421→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new issues exist.
   422→        issues = state.get("issues", {})
   423→        current_review_ids = {
   424→            fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   425→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   426→            and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   427→        }
   428→        triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   429→        new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   430→
   431→        if new_since_triage:
   432→            # New review issues appeared — re-triage needed
   433→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   434→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   435→            existing = set(order)
   436→            injected_count = 0
   437→            for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):
   438→                if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   439→                    order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   440→                    injected_count += 1
   441→            if injected_count:
   442→                result.injected = True
   443→        else:
   444→            # Only resolved issues changed the hash — update silently
   445→            meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   446→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   447→
   448→    return result
   449→

   543→        has_objective = policy.has_objective_backlog
   544→    else:
   545→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   546→        if unscored:
   547→            return result
   548→        issues = state.get("issues", {})
   549→        has_objective = any(
   550→            f.get("status") == "open"
   551→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   552→            for f in issues.values()
   553→        )
   554→    if not has_objective:
   555→        return result
   556→
   557→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items, at the end of the
   558→    # synthetic block (so create-plan comes after score-checkpoint).
   559→    insert_at = 0
   560→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   561→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   562→            insert_at = i + 1
   563→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   564→    result.injected = True
   565→    return result
   566→
   567→
   568→def compute_new_issue_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   569→    """Return the set of open review/concerns issue IDs added since last triage.
   570→
   571→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   572→    """
   573→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   574→    triaged = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", meta.get("synthesized_ids", [])))
   575→    current = {
   576→        fid for fid, f in state.get("issues", {}).items()
   577→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   578→    }
   579→    return current - triaged if triaged else set()
   580→
   581→
   582→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   583→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   584→
   585→    Returns True when genuinely *new* review issues appeared since the
   586→    last triage.  Triage stage IDs being in the queue alone is not
   587→    sufficient — the new issues that triggered injection may have been
   588→    resolved since then.
   589→
   590→    When issues are merely resolved (current IDs are a subset of
   591→    previously triaged IDs), triage is NOT stale — the user is working
   592→    through the plan.
   593→    """
   594→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   595→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   596→
   597→    # Always check for genuinely new issues (same logic regardless of
   598→    # whether triage stages are in the queue).
   599→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   600→    current_review_ids = {
   601→        fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   602→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   603→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   604→    }
   605→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   606→    new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   607→    if new_since_triage:
   608→        return True
   609→
   610→    # If triage stages are in queue but there's in-progress triage work,
   611→    # still consider it stale so the user finishes what they started.
   612→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   613→    if confirmed:
   614→        order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   615→        if order & TRIAGE_IDS:
   616→            return True
   617→
   618→    return False
   619→
   620→
   621→@dataclass
   622→class ImportScoresSyncResult:
   623→    """What changed during an import-scores sync."""
   624→
   625→    injected: bool = False
   626→
   627→    @property
   628→    def changes(self) -> int:
   629→        return int(self.injected)
   630→
   631→
   632→def sync_import_scores_needed(
   633→    plan: PlanModel,
   634→    state: StateModel,
   635→    *,
   636→    assessment_mode: str | None = None,
   637→) -> ImportScoresSyncResult:
   638→    """Inject ``workflow::import-scores`` after issues-only import.
   639→
   640→    Only injects when:
   641→    - Assessment mode was ``findings_only`` (scores were skipped)
   642→    - ``workflow::import-scores`` is not already in the queue
   643→    - There are assessments in the payload that could be imported
   644→
   645→    Positioned after score-checkpoint, before create-plan.
   646→    """
   647→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   648→    result = ImportScoresSyncResult()
   649→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   650→
   651→    if WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID in order:
   652→        return result
   653→
   654→    # Only inject when scores were skipped (issues-only mode)
   655→    if assessment_mode != "findings_only":
   656→        return result
   657→
   658→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items
   659→    insert_at = 0
   660→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   661→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   662→            insert_at = i + 1
   663→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID)
   664→    result.injected = True
   665→    return result
   666→
   667→
   668→@dataclass
   669→class CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   670→    """What changed during a communicate-score sync."""
   671→
   672→    injected: bool = False
   673→
   674→    @property
   675→    def changes(self) -> int:
   676→        return int(self.injected)
   677→
   678→
   679→def sync_communicate_score_needed(
   680→    plan: PlanModel,
   681→    state: StateModel,
   682→    *,
   683→    scores_just_imported: bool = False,
   684→) -> CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   685→    """Inject ``workflow::communicate-score`` after scores are imported.
   686→
   687→    Only injects when:
   688→    - Scores were just imported (trusted or attested)
   689→    - ``workflow::communicate-score`` is not already in the queue
   690→
   691→    Positioned after import-scores/score-checkpoint, before create-plan.
   692→    """
   693→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   694→    result = CommunicateScoreSyncResult()
   695→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   696→
   697→    if WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID in order:
   698→        return result
   699→
   700→    if not scores_just_imported:
   701→        return result
   702→
   703→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items
   704→    insert_at = 0
   705→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   706→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   707→            insert_at = i + 1
   708→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID)
   709→    result.injected = True
   710→    return result
   711→

    79→    max_parallel_raw = option_value(
    80→        options=options,
    81→        legacy_options=legacy_options,
    82→        name="max_parallel_workers",
    83→        default=base.max_parallel_workers,
    84→    )
    85→    max_parallel_workers = (
    86→        int(max_parallel_raw)
    87→        if isinstance(max_parallel_raw, int) and not isinstance(max_parallel_raw, bool)
    88→        else None
    89→    )
    90→    heartbeat_raw = option_value(
    91→        options=options,
    92→        legacy_options=legacy_options,
    93→        name="heartbeat_seconds",
    94→        default=base.heartbeat_seconds,
    95→    )
    96→    heartbeat_seconds = (
    97→        float(heartbeat_raw)
    98→        if isinstance(heartbeat_raw, int | float) and not isinstance(heartbeat_raw, bool)
    99→        else None
   100→    )
   101→    clock_fn_raw = option_value(
   102→        options=options,
   103→        legacy_options=legacy_options,
   104→        name="clock_fn",
   105→        default=base.clock_fn,
   106→    )
   107→    clock_fn = clock_fn_raw if callable(clock_fn_raw) else time.monotonic
   108→
   109→    return BatchExecutionOptions(
   110→        run_parallel=run_parallel,
   111→        max_parallel_workers=max_parallel_workers,
   112→        heartbeat_seconds=heartbeat_seconds,
   113→        clock_fn=clock_fn,
   114→    )
